Done! Here's a summary of what was implemented:

### Files Created/Modified

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `TicketClassifier.csproj` | Added `Microsoft.ML 4.0.2` package |

| `Controllers/TicketClassifierController.cs` | API endpoints |
| `Program.cs` | Service registration |

### Endpoints

- **`POST /api/ticketclassifier/predict`** — Accepts `{subject, description, priority}`, returns predicted category + per-class confidence scores
- **`GET /api/ticketclassifier/metrics`** — Returns macro/micro accuracy, log loss, and per-class precision/recall/F1

### Pipeline

Text features from Subject and Description are featurized independently, concatenated with Priority, normalized, then fed to an SDCA Maximum Entropy multiclass classifier. Label key values are extracted from the trained model's schema to ensure correct score-to-label mapping.
